scope: AEMO NEMWeb SA1; four 28-day out-of-time seasonal folds; 112 region-days; 50 AUD/MWh-discharged operating-cost proxy

method.training_signal: perfect-foresight optimiser actions from training days only
method.selection: preceding calibration mean improvement plus 20% lower-tail guardrail
method.boundary: optimiser-informed L1 sample weighting; not SPO+

selection_result.decision: rejected; small raw mean gain did not pass the pre-test calibration/tail gate

economic_boundary: Historical spot-market operating-margin proxy only. Excludes CAPEX, fixed O&M, network fees, FCAS, bidding/settlement complexity and investment returns.
